meta.title: Master QCS (MQCS): refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as the non-Buyer and Buyer users on the same Enterprise tenant and compare whether Master QCS is refused or available based on the Buyer role.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as the non-Buyer and Buyer users on the same Enterprise tenant and compare whether Master QCS is refused or available based on the Buyer role.

steps.note: Reach a prepared Master QCS event with bids so the role-based access check can be performed without creating unrelated test data.

args.need: sign in as the user without the Buyer role and then as a Buyer on the same Enterprise tenant, verify that Master QCS is refused or absent for the former and available for the latter

steps.note: Role-specific sign-in and RBAC comparison are not expressible by catalog steps.
Assert that the Buyer session ends with the Master QCS capability visible.
